title: Practice 6: до-: as far as, reaching

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Кто ___ (донести / доносить — to carry, to bring, to deliver) на меня из мести?
exercises.why: **донести́** — **доноси́ть** — to carry (to, as far as), to bring (to), to deliver; to report, to announce, to inform. **довести́** — **доводи́ть** — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald. **довезти́** — **довози́ть** — to take (to), to carry (as far as, to), to bring (to, as far as). — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Александр Беляев, «Человек-амфибия».
exercises.context: донести́** — **доноси́ть — to carry (to, as far as), to bring (to), to deliver; to report, to announce, to inform.

exercises.q: Граф сами до всего ___ (доходить / дойти — to come to, to arrive at, to reach).

Толстой, «Царь Фёдор Иоаннович».
